title: 2D ops cannot start below the material top: the entry rapids into uncut stock, so the air pass at Top cannot be avoided

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found while programming a simple 2.5D end-cap plate (user's project) with the CamCraft **v0.19.0** release CLI (macOS arm64), driven headlessly over MCP. Re-checked on upstream main **d00243a5**: **still reproduces, identical output**.

## What happens

Every 2D depth ladder cuts its first level at `top_z` (#514, kept by the maintainer on 2026-11-11). When Top is the faced material top, that level is a full pass in air. The obvious way to avoid it, setting Top to the first real cut, is **refused**: the entry rapids straight down to Top + the plunge height, which is inside the uncut stock above Top, and verify convicts it:

`rapid move 1 travels below the clearance plane inside stock`

So the air pass cannot be avoided. In the user's project the bore adaptive (2D Adaptive, three 0.25 in levels) keeps an air level at the faced top: **about 5.6 of its 16.9 min**.

Repro (main and v0.19.0 alike), a plate in stock 0.5 mm taller, faced to the part top first, `stepdown: 4`, bottom at the part bottom:

| op | `top_z` | levels (z) | first moves | verify |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2D Adaptive (bore) | TOS -0.5 (faced top) | 10 (air), 6, 2, 0 | rapid to z 12, feed down | ok |
| 2D Adaptive (bore) | TOS -4.5 | 6, 2, 0 | **rapid to z 8** (stock is at z 10) | `rapid move 1 travels below the clearance plane inside stock` |
| 2D Contour inside (bore) | TOS -0.5 | 10 (air), 6, 2, 0 | rapid to z 12, plunge | ok |
| 2D Contour inside (bore) | TOS -4.5 | 6, 2, 0 | **rapid to z 8** | same message, moves 1 and 5 |

The rapid law is right to convict a rapid into stock; the generator is what puts it there.

## Minimal repro (MCP)

`plate_bore.stl`: a 100 x 60 x 10 mm plate, centred, z 0..10, with a centred Ø40 through bore.

```
import_model   {"path": "plate_bore.stl", "name": "plate"}
add_setup      {"name": "Setup 1"}
set_stock      {"box": {"dx": 110, "dy": 70, "dz": 10.5}}
set_wcs        {"stock_point": {"x": "center", "y": "center", "z": "max"}}
add_tool       {"catalog": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "EM6"}
add_operation  {"kind": "Face", "tool": "EM6", "name": "face", "params": {"cut_z": {"reference": "top_of_stock", "offset": -0.5}}}
add_operation  {"kind": "2D Adaptive", "tool": "EM6", "name": "op", "source": "plate",
                "params": {"top_z": {"reference": "top_of_stock", "offset": -4.5},
                           "bottom_z": {"reference": "top_of_stock", "offset": -10.5}, "stepdown": 4}}
set_operation_geometry {"operation": "op", "picks": [the bore's top chain]}
generate {} ; verify {}  -> "rapid move 1 travels below the clearance plane inside stock"
```

## Expected

An op whose Top is below the material standing over it enters safely: it rapids to the plunge height above the **material actually there** (the prior stock, or the stock top), then feeds (helix, ramp or plunge) down to its first level. Then a user can set Top to the first real cut and skip the air pass, without reopening the #514 ladder decision.

## Done means

- The repro above (Adaptive and Contour, Top 4 mm below the faced top) generates an entry that rapids no lower than the plunge height above the remaining material and feeds the rest; verify is clean; pinned by a test for each.
- The rapid law (#96, #1066, #1091 pins) is unchanged.

Related: #514 (the air level at Top, won't-do for now), #1066.
